3073.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-52824: Kimai: Default APP_SECRET in Docker Image Enab
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("entrypoint.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/opt/kimai/var/data/.appsecret", "/opt/kimai/.env.local") or FileName in~ ("entrypoint.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3073.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-52824: Kimai: Default APP_SECRET in Docker Image Enab ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("entrypoint.sh"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/opt/kimai/var/data/.appsecret*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/opt/kimai/.env.local*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("entrypoint.sh"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

3074.sent:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let loginIPs = AppServiceHTTPLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where CsMethod == "POST" and CsUriStem has "login"   // Kimai/Symfony form-login check route
    | distinct CIp;
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where CsUriStem has_any ("/admin/", "/api/", "/user")   // authenticated Kimai surfaces
| where ScStatus >= 200 and ScStatus < 400
| where CsUsername != "" or Cookie has "KIMAI_REMEMBER"    // session was authenticated
| where CIp !in (loginIPs)                                 // but no form login ever seen from this IP
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Requests = count(), Paths = make_set(CsUriStem, 20) by CIp, UserAgent, CsUsername
| order by FirstSeen desc
3074.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*/en/admin/*" OR Web.url="*/api/*" OR Web.url="*/en/users*" OR Web.url="*/en/user/*") Web.status>=200 Web.status<400 by Web.src, Web.http_user_agent, Web.url, Web.status
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| search NOT [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=POST Web.url="*login*" by Web.src | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | fields src ]
| stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime sum(count) as requests values(url) as urls by src, http_user_agent
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime

| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("python","python3","curl","wget","scp","sftp","bash","sh","nc","ncat")

| where Timestamp between (CfgTime .. CfgTime + Window)
